name: Adaptive Editor
description: Fusion-style adaptive moves for the PCB Editor: drag selected footprints or a board edge; neighbours are shoved within the rules, copper legs re-aim, and the result is previewed before it is applied as one undo step.

actions.name: Adaptive Drag
actions.description: Move the selected footprints; neighbours shove (cascade or explicit), copper legs re-aim. Preview, then apply as one undo step.

actions.name: Adaptive Edge Move
actions.description: Move the selected straight Edge.Cuts segment along its normal (grow or shrink the board); parts in the way are pushed inward. Preview, then apply as one undo step.
